exposure: Patients who underwent the modified in utero myelomeningocele closure
Patients who underwent fetal repair as part of the MOMS study
Modified surgical technique (without uterine trocar and with minimized amniotic membrane separation)
outcome: Proportion of infants born at term (37 weeks or greater)
cohort: 43 patients who underwent in utero myelomeningocele closure with a modified technique at the Fetal Center at Vanderbilt from March 2011 to January 2013.
finding: The modified surgical technique for in utero myelomeningocele closure, which avoids the use of a uterine trocar and minimizes amniotic membrane separation, was associated with a decreased rate of premature rupture of membranes, chorioamnion separation, and early preterm delivery compared to the earlier MOMS technique.
